use default

magic_square(n: int) -> LIST[int] is
    let cells =
        stream(0, v => v || v + 1) |> take(n * n) |> map(_ => 0) |> collect_list()

    let row mut = 0
    let column mut = n / 2

    for value in 1::(n * n) do
        cells[row * n + column] = value

        let next_row mut = (row + n - 1) % n
        let next_column mut = (column + 1) % n

        if cells[next_row * n + next_column] == 0 then
            row = next_row
            column = next_column
        else
            row = (row + 1) % n
        fi
    od

    cells
